text:
Sam R.: Heading to Berlin for a 3-month project. Can I stay on Redwood medical? Any tips re: filling prescriptions and seeing a doctor locally?

Will - People Ops: You can stay on the US plan while on temporary assignment. Emergency care is covered; routine local care is usually out-of-network. Two quick notes: 1) For prescriptions, use an international pharmacy — keep receipts; 2) If you expect ongoing meds, get a 90-day supply before leaving or ask your doc for an international prescription.

Benefits Bot: Reminder: update temporary address in Workday if abroad >30 days. Submit any foreign invoices to benefits@redwood.com.

Sam R.: How do I submit a foreign hospital bill? Paperwork? Translations?

Will - People Ops: Send a scanned itemized bill, proof of payment, and a simple English translation if not in English. Here's a checklist:
- Itemized invoice (date, diagnosis, services)
- Proof of payment (bank/cc)
- Translation (attestation okay)
- Your Redwood emp ID and DOB

Rhea - Payroll: No change to deductions while payroll active. If assignment extends >6 months we'll review benefits eligibility and tax implications.

Sam R.: Thanks! Can you send the digital ID card and specialty telehealth links?

Will - People Ops: Sending the PDF to your email now and linking telehealth vendor. If you need pre-approval for an expensive procedure, loop benefits before booking. :thumbsup:
